text:
We went to MH (Netanya branch) this morning so you don't have to - here's what we found out:

our a5 visa appointment was cancelled due to the war and we didn't get any renewal sms or email or anything. in the meantime, naturally, our b1 visa had expired. we wanted to know:

do we have a valid visa?

probably, we need to email them and ask what's our new extended expiration date.

can we travel abroad and return with no issue?

if there's an auto extension - yes.

what about a new appointment for the a5?

they're re-scheduling all cancelled appointments now. it will take a while, and will be in accordance with the visa extension expiration date.

האגודה הישראלית לזוגות בינלאומיים aic.org.il @

do you have any info regarding whether or not status upgrade appointments will get higher priority vs status extensions?
